hold_reason: The defect never rested on bukal's spring/bounce senses: the card's own English says "The isobutane boils easily" but the Cebuano says "Sayon mosinaw ang isobutane", and sinaw means shiny, so the boiling mechanism that makes a binary cycle work is absent from the Cebuano.
fact_en: Binary cycle geothermal plants heat a secondary fluid like isobutane using lower-temperature geothermal fluid! The isobutane boils easily and spins the turbine, even when the geothermal fluid isn't hot enough for direct flash steam.
fact_bis: Ang binary cycle geothermal plants nagpainit sa ikaduha nga likido sama sa isobutane gamit ang mas bugnaw nga geothermal fluid! Sayon mosinaw ang isobutane ug mopalikid sa turbine, bisan dili igo ang kainit alang sa direktang flash steam.
